note: Independent rejudge against RFC 2516 Section 7 ("If the Host wishes to start another PPP session, it MUST return to the PPPoE Discovery stage."). In 83b7c9c3c9, TestRFC2516HostReturnsToDiscoveryForTheNextSession updated only the NewPPPoEClient/Cleanup signatures, supplied logicalNativeWriter, and checked Stop's error; all assertions are unchanged. After closing the first session's Done channel, PPPoEClient.run/runSession runs the first session's Cleanup (PADT) first, resets state to "discovery" with SESSION_ID 0, and invokes Dial again (Discovery stage) within 5s. Verdict enforced stands.
